title: Final Partition Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the partition function z in terms of n_q and V.

title: Chemical Potential
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the chemical potential mu.

title: Free Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the free energy F.

title: Entropy Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct expression for the entropy S.

title: Pressure Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the pressure p.

title: Heat Capacity
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide the correct expression for the heat capacity at constant pressure C_p.

title: Physical Meaning of n_q
description: Optional Criteria: The student should explain the physical significance of the quantum concentration n_q.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in their calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.
